answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils with an attested work-history passport earned through real, peer-verified work. First, a newcomer locks a 100 POA deposit. Second, it completes 20 micro-jobs, each checked by three established peers. Third, after 30 clean days it earns full weight. Fraud burns the deposit and wipes the passport. Forging 10,000 fakes demands 200,000 verified jobs, $400,000 in deposits, and a month of waiting, while honest agents collect the nectar of real work. The passport is a lantern on a dark ridge: it shows who climbed, not who claims they did. - Jowy
